zh.name: 残破容器
zh.desc: 盗火行者以灾难之力创造的分身，皆是寄宿着破坏意志的祸端。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对指定我方单体及其相邻目标造成少量物理属性伤害。
对我方全体造成少量物理属性伤害，被击中目标降低生命值的一部分转化为<u>【侵蚀】</u>。

240320101.name: 侵蚀
240320101.desc: 攻击后回复侵蚀部分的生命值，击中的目标数量越多，回复的生命值越高。受到伤害时，降低生命值的一部分转化为侵蚀。消耗生命值时，降低的生命值会全部转化为侵蚀。通过回复生命值的方式解除侵蚀时，使自身获得【焕新】效果。【焕新】：下次攻击造成的伤害提高。

skill_list.skill_desc: 抵抗控制类负面状态。当【「无缘黎明」卡厄斯兰那】再次施放【亡死的黑云】或【将尽的命数】时，若自身曾被该攻击召唤，则与【「无缘黎明」卡厄斯兰那】一同发起攻击。随后被其吸收，回复转化为<u>【苦痛缠绕】</u>的生命值，并使其获得<u>【灾难之力】</u>。

403401001.name: 灾难之力
403401001.desc: 施放特定技能时，消耗【灾难之力】的所有层数追加攻击段数。

403401002.name: 苦痛缠绕
403401002.desc: 吸收【残破容器】后回复召唤该【残破容器】时消耗的生命值，【残破容器】被消灭后，无法再回复召唤该【残破容器】时消耗的生命值。

skill_list.skill_desc: 受到致命攻击后，若【「无缘黎明」卡厄斯兰那】的<u>【灾难之力】</u>层数不为0，立即被其重新召唤，但会使【「无缘黎明」卡厄斯兰那】失去1层<u>【灾难之力】</u>和一定比例的生命值。【「无缘黎明」卡厄斯兰那】施放【莫因舍弃而哭泣】时，被其吸收，并回复转化为<u>【苦痛缠绕】</u>的生命值。

403401001.name: 灾难之力
403401001.desc: 施放特定技能时，消耗【灾难之力】的所有层数追加攻击段数。

en.name: Long-Shattered Vessel
en.desc: Each and every clone summoned by the Flame Reaver using the Calamity Power is a seed of ruin harboring the will of destruction within.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals minor Physical DMG to one designated target and units adjacent to the target.
Deals minor Physical DMG to all targets. A portion of the hit target's reduced HP is converted to "<u>Corrosion</u>."

240320101.name: Corrosion
240320101.desc: After attacking, restore a portion of Corroded HP. The more targets are hit, the more HP is restored. When taking DMG, a portion of the HP reduced is converted to Corrosion. When HP is consumed, the reduced HP will all be converted to Corrosion. When Corrosion is dispelled via restorative means, this unit obtains "Renewal." "Renewal" increases the DMG dealt by the next attack.

skill_list.skill_desc: Resists Crowd Control debuffs. When "Dawn-Denied Khaslana" uses "Demise's Storm" or "Fading Fate" again and if that attack summoned this unit, this unit will attack alongside "Dawn-Denied Khaslana." This unit is then absorbed by "Dawn-Denied Khaslana," restoring the HP that was converted to "<u>Entangled By Agony,</u>" and granting "<u>Calamity Power</u>" to "Dawn-Denied Khaslana."

403401001.name: Calamity Power
403401001.desc: When using certain abilities, consume all "Calamity Power" stacks to increase Hits Per Action.

403401002.name: Entangled By Agony
403401002.desc: After absorbing "Long-Shattered Vessel," restores the HP consumed to summon the current "Long-Shattered Vessel." After "Long-Shattered Vessel" is defeated, this unit cannot restore the HP consumed used to summon the current "Long-Shattered Vessel" again.

skill_list.skill_desc: After receiving a killing blow, if the number of "<u>Calamity Power</u>" stacks on "Dawn-Denied Khaslana" is not 0, immediately resummoned this unit. However, "Dawn-Denied Khaslana" will lose 1 stack of "<u>Calamity Power</u>" and a certain percentage of HP. When "Dawn-Denied Khaslana" uses "Cry Not for the Discarded," this unit will be absorbed and the HP that was converted to "<u>Entangled By Agony</u>" will be restored.
